topic: What trade-offs exist between array size and radiation efficiency for SIW arrays in high-gain inter-satellite antennas?
consensus_response: Larger SIW arrays amplify signal overlap, leading to increased interference and reduced spectral efficiency. This trade-off necessitates careful design choices balancing gain with minimizing insertion loss. Element spacing plays a crucial role in mitigating path length variations and maximizing radiation efficiency.  Substrate material properties significantly impact both performance and interference mitigation.
reference_context: SIW arrays exhibit high gain but also amplify signal overlap, leading to increased interference. Array size impacts spectral efficiency and network capacity, requiring careful design choices for optimal inter-satellite communication.
